headline: To Curb Excessive Investor Leverage, Cross-Industry Credit Inquiry Mechanism for Banks and Brokerages to Go Live End of October | Industry
summary: The Financial Supervisory Commission said a cross-industry credit inquiry mechanism for banks and brokerages is expected to go live at the end of October. It aims to curb excessive investor leverage.
why: Banks and brokerages are the main lenders for margin and retail credit, so tighter credit checks affect their risk and trading volumes.
